source.name: USDA FoodData Central, SR Legacy (April 2018); iodine: USDA, FDA and ODS-NIH Database for the Iodine Content of Common Foods, Release 4 (October 2024)

notes.folate: µg DFE (dietary folate equivalents); food folate where SR gives no DFE - the same number for unfortified food
notes.vitD: Vitamin D2 + D3 in µg (FDC nutrient 1114, SR 328); from IU / 40 where only IU is given
notes.epaDha: g EPA (20:5 n-3) + DHA (22:6 n-3); DPA (22:5 n-3) not included
notes.ala: g ALA (18:3 n-3); total 18:3 where SR does not split it
notes.iodine: SR Legacy rarely gives iodine; the Iodine Database row with the same SR number, or a listed stand-in (same food, another variant or state); null where neither exists
